name: Language server choice
responsibility: Chooses the command that starts the language server of a language in a checkout: the configured one, else for TypeScript the checkout's own
description: A configured server wins and runs as an editor's would. TypeScript has a default that reads the checkout's own node_modules/typescript at its root. Version 7 or later runs its native tsc --lsp --stdio. An earlier version, which has no --lsp, runs typescript-language-server from the checkout's node_modules/.bin or the server's PATH, told to use the checkout's lib/tsserver.js. Without either, a checkout of Archboard falls back to Archboard's own native tsc, and a release, which ships no TypeScript, reports the server as missing and says why. The TypeScript that the choice read is reported with the check's timings.

outgoing.label: whether Archboard has a TypeScript of its own
